title: Marginalization via the Schur Complement
hints: Split with blocks: A = H.topLeftCorner(na,na), B = H.topRightCorner(na,nc), C = H.bottomRightCorner(nc,nc); likewise b.head(na), b.tail(nc).
Eliminate Δc from the second block row: Δc = C⁻¹(b_c − Bᵀ Δa). Substitute it into the first row.
H' = A − B C⁻¹ Bᵀ, b' = b_a − B C⁻¹ b_c. Compute C⁻¹Bᵀ and C⁻¹b_c with one C.ldlt() and two solve() calls, not inverse().
solveViaSchur: Δa = H'.ldlt().solve(b'), then back-substitute Δc = C.ldlt().solve(b_c − Bᵀ Δa).
